learning_outcomes.text: Awareness of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, project, and research, and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.

Practical application of engineering: General ideas about economic, organizational and management issues (such as project management, risk and change management) in the industrial and business context.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Applies methods, techniques, regulations, etc., specific to the engineering profession in known contexts.

syllabus_topics: Execution of tasks assigned by the company

assessment_methods.method: Technical capacity, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation delivered, technical presentation and defense
Observation of student participation and attitude in the proposed training activities

assessment_rules: The course will have continuous assessment based on meetings with tutors. With the feedback offered in these meetings and partial submissions, students must improve the quality of their work, activity, report, and presentation until the final evaluation. If the course is not passed or the final report is not submitted, the course must be repeated. There are no recovery mechanisms for the evaluation activities.
